candidates.formal_type:
{V : Type u} →
  [inst : AddCommGroup.{u} V] →
    [inst_1 : Module.{0, u} Complex V] →
      [FiniteDimensional.{0, u} Complex V] →
        InnerProductSpace.Core.{0, u} Complex V →
          LinearEquiv.{0, 0, u, u} (RingHom.id.{0} Complex) (Etingof.Conjugate.{u} V) (Module.Dual.{0, u} Complex V)

∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group.{u_1} G] {V : Type u} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u} V] [inst_2 : Module.{0, u} Complex V]
  [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional.{0, u} Complex V] (ρ : Representation.{0, u_1, u} Complex G V)
  (c : InnerProductSpace.Core.{0, u} Complex V),
  (∀ (g : G) (v w : V),
      Eq.{1}
        (Inner.inner.{0, u} Complex
          (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (u_1 + 1), u_1 + 1, u + 1} ρ g) v)
          (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (u_1 + 1), u_1 + 1, u + 1} ρ g) w))
        (Inner.inner.{0, u} Complex v w)) →
    ∀ (g : G) (v : Etingof.Conjugate.{u} V),
      Eq.{u + 1}
        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Etingof.conjEquivDual.{u} c)
          (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
            (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (u_1 + 1), u_1 + 1, u + 1} (Etingof.conjugateRep.{u, u_1} ρ) g) v))
        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (u_1 + 1), u_1 + 1, u + 1} (Representation.dual.{0, u_1, u} ρ) g)
          (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Etingof.conjEquivDual.{u} c) v))

∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group.{u_1} G] {V : Type u} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u} V] [inst_2 : Module.{0, u} Complex V]
  [FiniteDimensional.{0, u} Complex V] [Fintype.{u_1} G] (ρ : Representation.{0, u_1, u} Complex G V),
  Exists.{u + 1} fun e =>
    ∀ (g : G) (v : Etingof.Conjugate.{u} V),
      Eq.{u + 1}
        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} e
          (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
            (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (u_1 + 1), u_1 + 1, u + 1} (Etingof.conjugateRep.{u, u_1} ρ) g) v))
        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (u_1 + 1), u_1 + 1, u + 1} (Representation.dual.{0, u_1, u} ρ) g)
          (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} e v))
